ai.title: AI drafting
ai.userHint: Draft reply writes a suggested answer for you to edit and send — nothing is sent on its own. Bring your own key, or use the server default if your admin set one. Keys are stored encrypted.
ai.instanceHint: Everyone without their own key drafts with this. Workers AI bills this Cloudflare account; a shared key bills whoever owns it.
ai.instanceOff: No server default — people can still bring their own key.
ai.usingInstance: Drafting with the server default: {provider} · {model}. Save your own key to use it instead.
ai.notSetUp: Not set up. Add your own key below, or ask an admin to set a server default.
ai.workersAiHint: Runs on this Cloudflare account through the Workers AI binding. No key needed.
ai.openaiHint: Any server that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions API — OpenAI, OpenRouter, sub2api, or your own gateway. Use the base URL that ends in /v1.
ai.anthropicHint: Leave the base URL blank for api.anthropic.com. For a proxy, use its URL without /v1.
ai.geminiHint: Use your own Google project and API key with Google’s fixed official API address. Usage limits and charges depend on that project; this app does not enable billing. Google’s free services prohibit submitting sensitive, confidential or personal information. Use private mail only when the terms applicable to your account and project permit it.
ai.keepKey: Saved key ending {hint} — leave blank to keep it
ai.noEncryptionKey: This server can't store API keys yet. Ask an admin to set the ENCRYPTION_KEY secret.
ai.noEncryptionKeyAdmin: Set the ENCRYPTION_KEY secret (32+ random characters) before saving keys: openssl rand -base64 32 | bunx wrangler secret put ENCRYPTION_KEY
ai.removeOwnConfirm: Remove your AI key? Drafting falls back to the server default, if there is one.
ai.removeInstanceConfirm: Remove the server default? People without their own key can no longer draft.
ai.instructionsHint: Used for every draft, whichever model writes it: who you are, your tone, what never to promise.
ai.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. I run research partnerships at a university lab. Keep replies short and warm. Never commit to dates or prices.
ai.oauthHint: Authorize an available service on its official website. API key connections remain available below.
ai.openrouterOauthHint: Authorize with OpenRouter without pasting a key. The credential is stored encrypted. Only free models are enabled; availability and limits depend on OpenRouter.
ai.openrouterFreeHint: Use openrouter/free or a model ID ending in :free. Paid models are disabled for this connection; the API address is fixed.
ai.oauthUnavailable: The administrator has not enabled secure AI account authorization yet.
ai.chatgptOauthUnavailable: ChatGPT account sign-in for a remotely hosted app requires OpenAI approval. This app has not been approved. You can still use an OpenAI API key below.
ai.claudeOauthUnavailable: This app has not been approved to offer Claude account sign-in. You can still connect with an Anthropic API key below.
ai.connectFirst: Connect OpenRouter above before saving a free model.
ai.oauthConnected: OpenRouter connected. AI drafting is ready with free models.
ai.oauthInvalid: The authorization response was invalid. Start the connection again.
ai.oauthExpired: The authorization request expired. Start the connection again.
ai.oauthCancelled: Authorization was cancelled. You can connect again when ready.
ai.oauthFailed: Could not complete authorization. Please try connecting again.
ai.removeOAuthConfirm: Remove your authorized AI connection? Drafting falls back to the server default, if there is one.
ai.cancelPendingOAuthConfirm: Cancel all pending OpenRouter authorizations? Previously opened authorization pages will no longer connect an account.
ai.pendingOAuthCancelled: Pending AI authorizations cancelled. Previously opened authorization pages can no longer connect an account.

mailRetention.title: Mail retention
mailRetention.description: Two independent rules for this account, both off by default. Changes take effect only after saving.
mailRetention.readLabel: Automatically move read mail to Trash
mailRetention.readHint: The timer starts when a message is marked as read. Marking it unread resets the timer; restoring a read message starts a new timer.
mailRetention.readProtected: Only read, unstarred incoming Inbox messages are included. Archived mail, Spam, Sent and Drafts are excluded.
mailRetention.trashHint: The timer starts when a message enters Trash, including messages moved by the read-mail rule.
mailRetention.trashWarning: Permanently deletes expired Trash, including starred mail, attachments and original messages. This cannot be undone.
mailRetention.invalidDays: Enter a whole number from 1 to 3650.
mailRetention.scheduleHint: Background checks run hourly in batches, so cleanup is not immediate. Existing messages are included. File removal may be delayed while failed deletions are retried.
mailRetention.loadFailed: Could not load retention settings. Try again before making changes.
mailRetention.saveFailed: Could not save retention settings. Your changes have not been confirmed.

social.orSignIn: Or sign in with a linked account

social.notConfigured: The administrator has not configured {provider} sign-in yet.
social.loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. The account may not be linked or authorization may have expired. Sign in with your mailbox password, then link your account in Settings → Connections.
social.connectionFailed: Could not link the account. Authorization may have expired, been cancelled, or the account may already be linked elsewhere. Please try again.
social.connectedNotice: Account linked. You can now use it to sign in to this mailbox.
social.disconnectConfirm: Unlink {provider}? You can still sign in with your mailbox password.
